# Netflix4U

> Netflix4U is an ultra-fast, independent entertainment discovery portal and verified media catalog delivering structured factual metadata for global movies, web series, anime, K-dramas, Bollywood, Hollywood, South Indian cinema, and Hindi-dubbed releases.

## Core Navigation & Media Hubs

- [Netflix4U Home](https://netflix4u.in/): Primary catalog discovery and featured trending releases.
- [Movies Hub](https://netflix4u.in/movies): Comprehensive library of feature films across all genres, years, and directors.
- [Web Series Hub](https://netflix4u.in/series): Multi-season television shows, episode guides, and web series.
- [Trending Hub](https://netflix4u.in/trending): Daily verified trending movies and series ranked by real-time viewer demand.
- [Anime Hub](https://netflix4u.in/anime): Japanese animation with dual-audio dubbed and subtitled catalog entries.
- [K-Drama Hub](https://netflix4u.in/kdrama): Korean television dramas, thrillers, and romantic series.
- [Bollywood Hub](https://netflix4u.in/bollywood): Hindi cinema, musical blockbusters, and new OTT releases.
- [Hollywood Hub](https://netflix4u.in/hollywood): International box-office releases, franchises, and award winners.
- [South Indian Cinema](https://netflix4u.in/south-indian): Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada films.
- [Hindi Dubbed](https://netflix4u.in/hindi-dubbed): Dual-audio and regional dubbed releases.

## E-E-A-T Trust, Editorial & Legal Policies

- [About Netflix4U](https://netflix4u.in/about): Platform overview, mission, data sources (TMDB, IMDb), and technical architecture.
- [Editorial Policy](https://netflix4u.in/editorial-policy): Editorial standards, metadata verification principles, AI assistance disclosure, and commercial independence.
- [Corrections Policy](https://netflix4u.in/corrections-policy): Transparent correction procedure for reporting metadata errors, inaccurate cast, or broken streaming links.
- [Contact Support](https://netflix4u.in/contact): Official support desk, email communication, and Telegram channel.
- [Privacy Policy](https://netflix4u.in/privacy): User data protection, GDPR/CCPA standards, cookie disclosures, and advertising network transparency.
- [Terms of Service](https://netflix4u.in/terms): Platform usage terms, intellectual property guidelines, and user conduct.
- [DMCA Disclaimer](https://netflix4u.in/dmca): DMCA copyright compliance, designated agent contact, and takedown notice procedure.

## Canonical Entity Model & Identifiers

Netflix4U enforces stable identifiers for every indexed catalog record:
- `canonicalId`: Stable alphanumeric string (e.g., `tmdb-movie-1514863` or `tmdb-series-112470`).
- `tmdbId`: The Movie Database unique identifier used for canonical cast, crew, and artwork reconciliation.
- `imdbId`: Internet Movie Database title identifier (e.g., `tt16478058`) for entity cross-referencing.
- `contentType`: Explicit categorization strictly distinguishing `movie`, `series`, `anime`, and `kdrama`.

## Structured Data & Machine Readability

Every detail page on Netflix4U provides Schema.org JSON-LD structured data:
- `Movie`: Name, releaseDate, duration, genre, director, actor, image, aggregateRating, publisher.
- `TVSeries`: Name, startDate, genre, creator, actor, aggregateRating, publisher.
- `BreadcrumbList`: Complete hierarchical breadcrumb paths.
- `FAQPage`: Verified question-and-answer pairs extracted directly from page facts.
- Visible text and JSON-LD structured data are 100% synchronized with zero contradictions.

## Brand & Trademark Notice

Netflix4U is an independent informational discovery service. Netflix4U is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or operated by Netflix, Inc., or any other subscription video-on-demand service.
